verified_public_partial_result: All but the last three sizes of every sufficiently large plateau have at least two non-similar minimizers; hence the good sizes have natural density one.
countermodel: A monotone integer o(n) function with increments on [2^(2k),2^(2k)+k-1] has unbounded strict-increase runs.
scope_guard: Neither the small OEIS data nor density one proves the eventual-for-all statement.
